Hale,

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite under 4.4, with nothing on his record, and she still wants the zero out of the gradebook and the terms in writing tonight, which is the fair outcome, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You answered each of her objections with a dated document she could check herself, the version history with its times and then the quotation that is not in the play.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and never let the argument drift onto Owen's character.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with edits late on the night of October 28 before the essay was due, came close to that kind of night, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in, you never answered, so say plainly what happened there the first time she asks.
